map.振动速度与旋转精度为单侧上限，裕度按「(上限 − 实测)/上限 × 100%」；: Vibration velocity and rotational accuracy are one-sided upper limits: (upper limit − measured)/upper limit × 100%. Clearance is a range item: the smaller of (measured − lower)/lower and (upper − measured)/upper. Meeting its limit is shown as met, otherwise not met. Limits are entered by you from design documents, operating conditions and acceptance requirements; this page has no built-in standard thresholds.
map.取设计限值 振动速度 ≤2.8 mm/s、游隙 5~20 μm、旋转精度 ≤5: With limits ≤2.8 mm/s vibration, 5–20 μm clearance and ≤5 μm accuracy, measured 2.0 mm/s / 12 μm / 3 μm gives margins +28.6% / +40.0% / +40.0%, minimum 28.6%, verdict "all 3 items meet design limits". If vibration is 3.5 mm/s and clearance 25 μm, margins are −25.0% and −25.0%, and the verdict becomes "2 items do not meet design limit".

map.游隙为什么是区间项？: Why is clearance a range item?
map.游隙过小易发热卡死、过大易冲击噪声，因此以「下限 ≤ 实测 ≤ 上限」判定，裕度: Too little clearance causes heat and seizure; too much causes impact and noise. Clearance is therefore checked as lower ≤ measured ≤ upper, with the smaller of the two side margins.
map.振动速度用 mm/s，游隙用 μm，旋转精度用 μm。实测值与设计限值必须使用同: Vibration velocity in mm/s, clearance in μm, rotational accuracy in μm. Measured values and design limits must use the same unit.
map.振动实测建议在约定转速与测点下取得，并与比较基准保持一致: Measure vibration at the agreed speed and measuring point, consistent with the comparison baseline.
map.设计限值须按设计文件、工况与验收要求填写，不要用本页默认值代替真实设计要求: Fill design limits from design documents, operating conditions and acceptance requirements; do not treat the defaults as real design requirements.
